gsm8k.selection_rule: Take the 64 smallest SHA256(seed + newline + zero-based index + newline + exact question), preserving hash order
gsm8k.scoring: Official ANS_RE.search and comma-removal string equality; no numeric relaxation or answer repair
gsm8k.reason: This is a fixed subset with an explicit zero-shot prompt, not the complete GSM8K benchmark or a replication of a published prompting setup

long_context.chat_template_tokens: Not included in targets; generation harness records actual prompt length
long_context.coverage: single lookup and two-hop lookup at early, middle, late locations
long_context.scoring: Exactly one non-empty output line: #### followed by the exact case-sensitive expected value

generation.max_tokens: Per-task requests.jsonl value; identical for both builds

paired_acceptance.rule: No baseline-correct to candidate-incorrect task, no missing/duplicate result, no request error, and no length-truncated response in either build
paired_acceptance.missing_or_truncated: Retain and report as failed/incomplete; cannot silently exclude
paired_acceptance.score_means: No observed task regressions on this frozen suite, not universal answer-quality equivalence
paired_acceptance.confidence: Report a one-sided 95% exact binomial bound on observed regression rate, with sampling assumptions and finite-suite limits; do not interpret a nonsignificant difference as equivalence
paired_acceptance.engineering_gate: Numerical/state parity and code-path activation are separate prerequisites owned by the runtime validation harness
